ModelProviderProbeStatus.description:
Outcome of a provider reachability check.

The model catalog falls back to a bundled list when a provider cannot be reached, so `model/list` succeeding says nothing about whether the configured provider actually works. These variants let a client tell a wrong key apart from a wrong address instead of reporting one generic failure.

oneOf.description: The provider answered and returned a usable model catalog.
The provider answered, but rejected the credential.
The provider answered with an error status.
The provider could not be reached at all (DNS, TLS, refused, timeout).
The provider answered, but the body was not a model catalog.

authenticated.description: Whether a credential was attached, so "works without auth" is visible.

endpoint.description: Endpoint the probe requested, for surfacing a wrong base URL.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status returned by the provider, when it answered at all.

message.description: Failure detail from the provider or transport.

modelCount.description: Models the provider advertised, when the catalog parsed.

providerId.description: Provider that was probed, so a client can tell which entry answered.
